intro: Derma Veda Oil is an ayurvedic topical blend crafted to comfort sensitive, irritated skin and support barrier repair. With regular use, it helps ease itching and redness while softening dry, rough patches so the skin feels calm and looks smoother. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without greasiness, making it ideal for daily face and body care across seasons. For best results, apply consistently as part of a gentle skincare routine; individual results may vary.

p: Ayurvedic skin‑soothing oil designed to calm redness, itching, and irritation on face and body.
Helps repair the skin barrier, reduce dryness and flaking, and support smoother texture.
Lightweight, fast‑absorbing oil that leaves a comfortable, non‑sticky finish suitable for daily use.
Nourishes with herbal actives to promote even‑looking skin tone and healthy glow.
Convenient 30 ml dropper for hygienic, targeted application at home or on the go.
Cleanse and pat dry. Apply 3–5 drops to affected areas; massage gently until absorbed.
Use 1–2 times daily. Layer under moisturizer for very dry skin.
Patch test recommended on the inner arm for 24 hours before first use.
